title: Plasma-derived exosomal preparation and isolation of RNA
author: Fernanda Svedman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tuienue
materials: MiRCURY Exosome Isolation Kit-Serum and Plasma

steps.title: Treat plasma with thrombin
steps.instruction: Treat 600 ml of plasma with thrombin for 5 minutes at room temperature to remove clotting factors.

steps.title: Precipitate plasmatic EVs
steps.instruction: Mix the supernatant with 200 ml of precipitation buffer (MiRCURY Exosome Isolation Kit-Serum and Plasma, Exiqon, Denmark) and incubate overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet EVs
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 10,000 g for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend EV pellet
steps.instruction: Vortex the pellet in 270 ml resuspension buffer for 5-15 minutes until completely re-suspended.

steps.title: Extract EV miRNA
steps.instruction: Extract the EV miRNA using the miRCURY RNA isolation kit-biofluids (Exiqon, Denmark) following the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Add RNA spike-in template
steps.instruction: Add RNA spike-in template mixture (Exiqon, Denmark) as a quality control for downstream PCR analysis.
